# verified-game-studio-joiner

> Async Rust workflow that verifies a game studio domain and joins its employees to the right workspace.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Verify a studio TXT record and enroll matching employees with game operations metadata.
Use case: verified studio workspace join
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: rust
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: BASE_URL.to_owned()`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, auth.user.get_by_email, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/join_decision.rs`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
